tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows sink-gradient dependence and possible endogenous adaptation, while its horizons are much shorter than the target H of 21.8. The slow-horizon probe addresses this genuine extrapolation and parameter-identifiability ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify five parameters or establish long-horizon adaptation.
The slow-horizon probe directly tests the suspected adaptation and target forecast horizon.
Short-horizon data alone do not distinguish it from a dynamic response.
